sloka: सो ऽभिवाद्य महात्मानं ज्वलन्तमिव तेजसा ।उवाच प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यं रामं सत्यपराक्रमम् ।। ७.७२.९ ॥
transliteration: so 'bhivādya mahātmānaṁ jvalantamiva tejasā ।uvāca prāñjalirvākyaṁ rāmaṁ satyaparākramam ।। 7.72.9 ॥

translations.english: Having saluted the great-souled Rama, who shone as if with his own splendor and possessed true valor, he spoke with folded hands.
